name: N-gram 빈도 분석
description: 분석합니다 word and character n-gram 분포s 감지하기 위해 패턴 characteristic of AI 생성 text.
useCase: Detecting AI text through 통계 분석 of word sequence 패턴
mechanism: 추출합니다 character-level and word-level n-gram frequency 분포s and compares them against known 분포s for human and AI 생성 text. AI text generators produce characteristic n-gram 패턴 — often over-representing common phrases and under-representing rare but natural human constructions.
source: Lavergne et al. (2008) - Detecting Fake Content with Relative Entropy Scoring, PAN-SEPLN
algorithm: N-gram Extraction + Frequency Distribution Analysis + KL-Divergence Scoring
parameters: N-gram sizes: 2-5, Level: character + word, Comparison: KL-divergence, chi-square, Corpus: reference 분포s
strengths:
• Language-model agnostic approach
• Can analyze very short texts
• 계산 효율적
• Captures subtle 분포 differences
limitations:
• Requires reference 분포s for calibration
• Domain-specific text may skew results
• Modern AI models converge toward natural 분포s
• Cross-domain generalization can be weak
